## 4. Evidence to criterion and evidence-aligned gap

A = cumulative rewarded samples in informative groups; B = cumulative informative groups (each up to the eval). E(L) = evidence at the accuracy crossing of 50% (with persistence, ±12), linearly interpolated between evals along accuracy, 0 = at or above 50% at step 0. R = E_c430 / E_oss430, R>1 means oss430 needed less; a never-reaching arm uses its final evidence as a lower bound. Gap = mean(acc_oss430 - acc_c430) on a common evidence grid up to the smaller arm's final evidence, raw, then baseline-corrected (bc: each arm's step-0 accuracy subtracted). Intervals over requests only.
